comparison.objective: Candidate screens finishing media from washers; PR installs both halves of a lever set through a bored door and tightens two screws.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires pouring and controlled agitation of many free bodies; PR requires hidden spindle/post alignment, counter-holding, screwdriver use, and maintaining lever level while fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades recovered media mass, retained washers, spill/damage, and released screen dwell; PR grades through/on/seated states, screw snugness, ≤1° level alignment, release, and rest.
comparison.reason: Granular screening does not test opposed-side hardware assembly or fastening; no material rubric detail is missing for novelty comparison.
